title: paper placemats
text: paper placemats. Purchased these for my 83 year old Mom's family birthday party.  They are PERFECT for her.  They are super large too.  Colorful. Artsy.  They are on a paper pad that you tear off as you need.  Pad of 24.  Spendy, but pretty and for special occasion - so I splurged.

description: Pad of 24 paper placemats with whimsical artwork by Vicki Sawyer. These practical kitchen papers are perfect for everything from modern farmhouse to traditional tablescapes. When Angie Hester married Robbie Cook, neither guessed their relationship would eventually lead to owning a successful business together. After eleven years of company growth, their three brands, CAKE Vintage, Kitchen Papers, and The Pencil Factory, have become one iconic brand, Hester and Cook. Their products are still made in the USA, and their vision remains focused on crafting authentic products with artistic and sometimes quirky designs.
